integrity.proof_basis: Fourier multiplicative-character splitting, exact stationary root count and two-root noncancellation, nonvanishing lower-conductor blocks.
integrity.verification: 140 integer stationary checks and 20 independently assembled complex-matrix SVD ranks; finite checks are not proofs.

scientific_limitations: Only odd primes and unit quadratic and linear coefficients modulo the prime square.
Neither higher prime-power exponents nor nonzero singular values nor a complete historical priority certification are established.
title: Exact rank and nullspace of quadratic-product Fourier kernels over prime-square rings
